text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hello? Is that the kiddos?
Ah, so ya watched the race, did ya?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I worked hard too, but wasn't the big sis I ran against amazing?
Yeah, she's also—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: She was just like me.
A few nights after the Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Coming in, Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Tama-chan...! I'm so sorry about
the other day. I just got carried away..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. Let's call it no side for now. Besides,
I'm the one who fired them up that much in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Saying that was entirely my mistake. I got her fired up enough
to steal the spotlight right from under me."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I told ya in the waiting room before the race, right?
About me...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat Trainer to a pulp too,
so they can't get back up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"That phrasing was bad of me. It sounded like
I was trying to get in the way of your future."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And with that, it lit a fire
under sweet old Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
choice_data_list: Super Creek, what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...If they were just taunting me, I wouldn't
have cared much. But..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Because I can't let anything
jeopardize your future, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Because having you become the best trainer in the world,
and watching over you until you do—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Because that is a wish of mine... that I cannot compromise on.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: After the race, seeing Creek's angry face made me realize with a start. That was—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's the face Ma makes when she's pissed.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The face of someone protecting the future
from those who try to trample on a child's dreams...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I thought you two were just a couple of lovebirds,
but I guess I was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We're basically family at this point. Before I knew it,
they were carrying the same heavy burden as me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout pickin' a fight with ya.
You guys are—the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan... No, the pleasure is mine.
Thank you for coming all this way to tell me♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Would you like to join me for dinner
today? You haven't eaten yet, have you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll make suuure to call your mom
at home, okay? Alright?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you my real mom or something?!
You don't gotta call all the way to Osaka!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... Seriously, I can't compete with that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Don't mind if I dig right in, though!
Creek's cookin' is seriously the best!"

Gathered around the dining table, enjoying lively chatter.
The two had completely gone back to being best friends.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thanks for the grub. Well, a match with Oguri
won't be all spark-flying intense like with me, I bet.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She's a bit of an airhead, y'know.
Well, try to get along with her.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right~
I'll just have fun with it~

A scary face really didn't suit Super Creek after all.
I prayed that next time, it would be a much gentler contest.
